messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: GPU_POOL_QUEUE_GROWTH triggered for us-west2-spot-pool at 1777777777. queue_length=4.2k, avg_latency=3.6s, consumer_errors=12/min. Severity: P1. Runbook: https://redwood.infra/runbooks/gpu-fallback

alice_sre: paging @jamie_oncall and @ben_autoscale — we're seeing a sustained queue build on us-west2 spot pool, autoscaler attempted scale but kept failing with quota/permission errors. Customers reporting timeouts.

jamie_oncall: on it. joining bridge. can someone paste the latest autoscaler logs?

ben_autoscale: pasting snippet from autoscaler logs:
```
ERROR createInstance: googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for project redwood-prod in region us-west2, quotaLimitExceeded
2026-02-12T10:21:43Z autoscaler/scale.go: failed to expand pool us-west2-spot: quota_exceeded
```

ben_autoscale: looks like quota was hit when trying to allocate 40 gpus for the burst. autoscaler retried 3x and then backed off.

rachel_infra: also seeing intermittent 1xx/5xx spikes from provider during the attempt window — could be provider-side capacity flapping. cloud console shows spot interruptions spiking at 69% in us-west2.

maria_support: we have multiple customers complaining: ticket #4521 (AcmePayments) showing tokenized requests failing; SLA alerts are firing. Let me know if we should proactively notify bigger customers.

jamie_oncall: summary for the bridge: queue spike due to spot interruption wave + autoscaler quota errors. Impact: generation requests delayed 2–6s, some requests retried and hit client-side timeouts, ~0.6% failed. Next steps: (1) attempt emergency manual scale to dedicated pool (2) enable degraded routing fallback to lower-cost reserved instance pool (3) throttle non-critical workloads.

alice_sre: doing (1) now: running redwoodctl scale --pool dedicated-usw2 --count +24 --reason "emergency fallback for spot wave"
```
> redwoodctl: scaling dedicated-usw2 to 24
> result: ok
```

ben_autoscale: switching routing policy: set route policy for model embeddings-prod to prefer dedicated-usw2 fallback when spot unavail. Command:
```
redwoodctl routing set --model embeddings-prod --primary spot-usw2 --fallback dedicated-usw2 --failover-threshold 50
```

rachel_infra: care: dedicated pool is near reserved capacity, scaling it consumed some reserved headroom. We'll need to keep an eye on cross-region spillover.

alice_sre: enabled rate-limiting on low-priority jobs (batch-embed, nightly-evals) to free tokens. config patch applied to api-gateway: `rate_limit: {prefix: "/v1/embeddings/batch", qps: 3}`.

maria_support: sending customer comms for impacted tenants: short blurb to AcmePayments + paymentgateway-prod customers. I'll mark as degraded and give ETA 1h.

ben_autoscale: autoscaler health shows repeated createInstance failures with HTTP 403 -> quota. We can either request quota increase (takes time) or re-balance by moving some long-lived jobs to another region. Quick manual move: shifting 30% of non-critical capacity to eu-west1 reserved pool.

jamie_oncall: assigning tasks: @ben_autoscale to triage autoscaler permissions/quota calls and open a quota request; @rachel_infra to monitor provider interruption graph and open cloud provider support ticket if interruptions persist; @alice_sre to coordinate routing and throttle rules; @maria_support to manage customer notifs.

ben_autoscale: opened a quota request with cloud provider — request id Q-99412, asking for immediate increase for region us-west2. Also noticed the service account used by autoscaler had a stale billing project binding, I just rotated it and restarted the autoscaler pod. watching for recovery logs.

incident-bot: ACTION: autoscaler restarted by ben_autoscale at 1777777832.

ben_autoscale: post-restart logs:
```
INFO autoscaler: recovered service-account-perms
INFO autoscaler: scale attempt: requested 40 GPUs -> provider returned 18 (partial fulfilment)
WARN autoscaler: partial_scale - will retry remaining 22 in 30s
```

alice_sre: partial fill still helps. queue processing rate increased ~35% after partial scale. queue length dropping but still above target.

rachel_infra: provider interruption rate down to 24% in us-west2 after 10m, likely the worst of the spot wave passed. But fallback headroom still tight.

jamie_oncall: good. next: add temporary circuit-breaker to limit concurrent generations per-API-key to 2 for impacted models to reduce queue tail latency. alice, can you apply?

alice_sre: done. small rollback if it breaks: `redwoodctl config apply --patch cb-limit`

maria_support: posting updated customer status: "Degraded — we have fallbacks in place, partial recovery ongoing, ETA 45m. We will update if situation changes." pinging top 5 impacted accounts.

ben_autoscale: two things to follow up after stabilization: (A) investigate autoscaler retry/backoff logic — current backoff too aggressive for partial fills, (B) add a preemptible-capacity-credit metric to avoid hitting quota hard. I'll open tickets.

jamie_oncall: provider ticket opened too: CT-33421 — provider acknowledges spot interruption wave and is investigating underlying hardware churn. They offered no immediate re-provision.

alice_sre: small postmortem notes while fresh:
- Trigger: provider spot wave caused mass preemptions in us-west2.
- Contribution: autoscaler failed to fully recover due to quota + service-account binding drift, leading to partial fills and slower queue drain.
- Mitigations applied: manual dedicated scale-up, routing failover, throttle of non-critical jobs, autoscaler restart with rotated credentials, customer communication.
- Outstanding: request quota bump, adjust autoscaler backoff and partial-fill behavior, add cross-region warm pool & pre-warmed reserved capacity, improve runbook step for service-account drift.

jamie_oncall: marking incident P1 -> transitioning to incident review channel. On-call rotation handoff to night shift in 40m, leaving follow-ups assigned. thanks all. :white_check_mark: 

maria_support: closing customer-facing message after update. will reopen if new failures pop.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: status moved to degraded->stabilizing by jamie_oncall at 1777777899. Metrics: queue_length reduced 82% from peak, error-rate back to baseline 0.07%.

alice_sre: quick check: will schedule a blameless postmortem doc and link runbook changes.

ben_autoscale: created follow-up tickets: RED-1182 (adjust autoscaler backoff), RED-1183 (prewarm reserved capacity), RED-1184 (service-account drift detection).

rachel_infra: thanks team. I'll keep an eye on us-west2 and escalate if provider churn resumes.

maria_support: no further customer escalations for now.

jamie_oncall: signing off for this bridge. final note: consider adding a fast-path to re-route critical low-latency traffic to dedicated pools automatically when partial_fill > 50% and fallback capacity exists.
